name: Kuray'bin
summary: Outside Splintertree Post, Kuray'bin keeps watch over Ashenvale's forest trails. The Darkspear scout guards the Horde encampment from night elf scouts.

sections.title: Eyes on the Forest Edge
sections.body: Kuray'bin watches the forest outside Splintertree Post for Alliance scouts. Silverwing Sentinels patrol the canopy and send swift outrunners across the border. They gather intelligence on Horde lumber operations and defenses. Kuray'bin sends Horde fighters after the outrunners before they can report to Silverwing Outpost. Left unchecked, the scouts can become an ambushing force.

faq.answer: Kuray'bin is a Darkspear troll watchman outside Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. He sends Horde fighters to hunt night elf scouts in the surrounding woods.
Kuray'bin stands just outside Splintertree Post's stockade gates, watching the road approaches in central-eastern Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why does Kuray'bin want the Silverwing Outrunners dead?
faq.answer: Silverwing Outrunners are Silverwing Sentinels scouting near Splintertree Post. Kuray'bin wants them stopped before they gather intelligence on Horde positions or coordinate surprise attacks.

faq.q: Does Kuray'bin offer any other tasks?
faq.answer: No. Kuray'bin oversees the effort against the night elf outrunners at the outpost perimeter.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can see why Kuray'bin keeps watch: night elf guerrillas could surround and overrun Splintertree Post.
As a troll, you share the jungle tracking instincts Kuray'bin uses to spot night elf scouts among the trees.
